## Intro

Refit the selected model from "01-fit-sdms-aic.qmd" and plot conditional effects of oxygen and temperature

## Load packages & source functions

```{r load libraries}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(tidylog)
library(RCurl)
library(devtools)
library(sdmTMB)
library(viridis)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(here)

# Source code for map plots
devtools::source_url("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/maxlindmark/spatial-metabolic-index/main/R/functions/map-plot.R")
options(ggplot2.continuous.colour = "viridis")

# Set path
home <- here::here()
```

## Read data

```{r read data}
# Read data
d <- readr::read_csv(paste0(home, "/data/clean/catch_clean.csv")) |>
  add_utm_columns(ll_names = c("lon", "lat")) |> 
  mutate(life_stage = ifelse(str_ends(group, "juvenile"), "juvenile", "adult"))
```

## Scale variables

```{r}
pred_grid <- bind_rows(readr::read_csv(paste0(home, "/data/clean/pred_grid_(1_3).csv")),
                       readr::read_csv(paste0(home, "/data/clean/pred_grid_(2_3).csv")),
                       readr::read_csv(paste0(home, "/data/clean/pred_grid_(3_3).csv")))

pred_grid <- pred_grid |>
  mutate(temp_sc = (temp - mean(temp)) / sd(temp),
         temp_sq = temp_sc^2,
         oxy_sc = (oxy - mean(oxy)) / sd(oxy),
         oxy_sq = oxy_sc^2,
         sal_sc = (sal - mean(sal)) / sd(sal),
         depth_sc = (depth - mean(depth)) / sd(depth),
         depth_sq = depth_sc*depth_sc,
         month_f = as.factor(month),
         year_f = as.factor(year))

d <- d |> 
  mutate(temp_sc = (temp - mean(pred_grid$temp)) / sd(pred_grid$temp),
         temp_sq = temp_sc^2,
         oxy_sc = (oxy - mean(pred_grid$oxy)) / sd(pred_grid$oxy),
         oxy_sq = oxy_sc^2,
         sal_sc = (sal - mean(pred_grid$sal)) / sd(pred_grid$sal),
         depth_sc = (depth - mean(pred_grid$depth)) / sd(pred_grid$depth),
         depth_sq = depth_sc*depth_sc,
         month_f = as.factor(month),
         year_f = as.factor(year))
```

## Fit the model that is preferred by the given group
Plot residuals, save model object, plot conditional effects!

```{r}
pred_list <- list()
pred_grid_list <- list()
res_list <- list()
cog_list <- list()

for(i in unique(d$group)) { 
    
    dd <- d |> filter(group == i)

    # For some combos, there are years without a single occurrence. This makes it hard to fit year_f models...
    dd <- dd |> 
      mutate(sum = sum(density), .by = year) |> 
      filter(sum > 0)
    
    mesh <- make_mesh(dd, xy_cols = c("X", "Y"), cutoff = 12)

    ggplot() +
      inlabru::gg(mesh$mesh) +
      coord_fixed() +
      geom_point(aes(X, Y), data = d, alpha = 0.2, size = 0.5) +
      annotate("text", label = paste(str_to_sentence(unique(dd$life_stage)), unique(dd$common_name)),
               x = -Inf, y = Inf, vjust = 1.5, hjust = -0.1,
               color = "gray40", size = 4) + 
      labs(x = "Easting (km)", y = "Northing (km)")
    
    ggsave(paste0(home, paste0("/figures/supp/mesh_", i, ".pdf")), width = 14, height = 14, units = "cm")

    if(i %in% c("cod_juvenile", "plaice_adult")){

      m <- sdmTMB(density ~ 0 + year_f + (1|month_f) + sal_sc + depth_sc + depth_sq + temp_sc + temp_sq + oxy_sc,
                  data = dd,
                  mesh = mesh,
                  family = tweedie(link = "log"),
                  spatiotemporal = "iid",
                  spatial = "on",
                  time = "year")

    } else if(i %in% c("dab_all", "flounder_adult", "turbot_all", "whiting_all")){
      m <- sdmTMB(density ~ 0 + year_f + (1|month_f) + sal_sc + depth_sc + depth_sq + temp_sc * oxy_sc,
                  data = dd,
                  mesh = mesh,
                  family = tweedie(link = "log"),
                  spatiotemporal = "iid",
                  spatial = "on",
                  time = "year")

    } else{

      m <- sdmTMB(density ~ 0 + year_f + (1|month_f) + sal_sc + depth_sc + depth_sq + temp_sc + temp_sq + breakpt(oxy_sc),
                  data = dd,
                  mesh = mesh,
                  family = tweedie(link = "log"),
                  spatiotemporal = "iid",
                  spatial = "on",
                  time = "year",
                  priors = sdmTMBpriors(
                    threshold_breakpt_slope = normal(0, 1),
                    threshold_breakpt_cut = normal(0, 1)))

      }
    
    # Check again to be safe...
    sanity(m)

    # Plot residuals
    res <- simulate(m, nsim = 300, type = "mle-mvn") |>
      dharma_residuals(m, plot = FALSE) |>
      mutate(group = i)
    
    # Store residuals
    res_list[[i]] <- res

    # Create prediction dfs for conditional effects
    nd <- data.frame(expand.grid(temp = seq(min(dd$temp) - 4,
                                            max(dd$temp) + 4,
                                            length.out = 50),
                                 oxy = seq(min(dd$oxy) - 4,
                                           max(dd$oxy) + 4,
                                           length.out = 50),
                                 month = 11)) |>
      mutate(temp_sc = (temp - mean(pred_grid$temp)) / sd(pred_grid$temp),
             temp_sq = temp_sc^2,
             oxy_sc = (oxy - mean(pred_grid$oxy)) / sd(pred_grid$oxy),
             year = min(dd$year),
             year_f = as.factor(min(dd$year)),
             month_f = as.factor(month),
             sal_sc = 0, 
             depth_sc = 0, depth_sq = 0,
             X = mean(dd$X),
             Y = mean(dd$Y),
             group = i)

    # Predict
    pred <- predict(m, newdata = nd, re_form = NA, re_form_iid = NA, se_fit = TRUE)
    
    pred_list[[i]] <- pred

    # Predict on grid 
    p <- predict(m, newdata = pred_grid |> 
                   filter(year %in% unique(dd$year))
                 ) |> mutate(group = i)
    
    pred_grid_list[[i]] <- p 
    
    # Predict on grid and get cog
    pcog <- predict(m, newdata = pred_grid |> 
                   filter(year %in% unique(dd$year)),
                          return_tmb_object = TRUE)
    
    cog <- get_cog(pcog, format = "wide") |> mutate(group = i)
            
    cog <- cog |>
      mutate_at(c("est_x", "lwr_x", "upr_x", "est_y", "lwr_y", "upr_y"),
                ~ . * 1000)
    
    cog_list[[i]] <- cog
    
}

# Save predictions
preds <- dplyr::bind_rows(pred_list)
preds_grid <- dplyr::bind_rows(pred_grid_list)
res <- dplyr::bind_rows(res_list)
cogs <- dplyr::bind_rows(cog_list)
```

```{r}
write_csv(res, paste0(home, "/output/residuals_02_sdms.csv"))
write_csv(preds, paste0(home, "/output/conditional_02_sdms.csv"))
write_csv(preds_grid, paste0(home, "/output/pred_grids_02_sdms.csv"))
write_csv(cogs, paste0(home, "/output/cogs_02_sdms.csv"))
```

## Plot residuals

```{r}
# Plot residuals
res |> 
  separate(group, into = c("common_name", "life_stage"), sep = "_", remove = FALSE) |> 
  mutate(group2 = paste(str_to_sentence(life_stage), common_name)) |>
  ggplot(aes(observed, expected)) +
  geom_point(color = "grey30", shape = 21, size = 0.5) +
  geom_abline(col = "tomato3", linewidth = 0.6) +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~group2) +
  labs(x = "Observed", y = "Expected")

ggsave(paste0(home, "/figures/supp/qq_sdm_02.pdf"), width = 17, height = 14, units = "cm")
```
